model.truth: Nonlinear inertial point-mass gravity, RK4, 1 s step
model.estimator: HCW linear Kalman filter, first-order Cartesian fix covariance
model.controller: Velocity-limited PD with HCW drift cancellation and heuristic retreat guard
model.frame: Target LVLH: x radial outward, y along-track, z orbit-normal
assumptions: Known, exact own attitude and target circular reference orbit
Synthetic range and bearing observations, not images
No target pose or tumble estimation
No contact, coupled-body control, radiation, thermal, battery, RF or reentry model
Health flags and the exact degraded-authority fraction are injected scenario inputs, not validated hardware telemetry or fault diagnosis
No delayed observations or correlated sensor biases in this campaign
Three-sigma bound is a model diagnostic, not certified coverage or collision probability
Finite numerical sample horizon, not a formal safety proof

events.event: Actuator health flag reports degraded authority
Actuator health flag reports degraded authority

interpretation: Frozen replay of two existing synthetic model runs, not the mechanism engine or flight telemetry. Ideal simulator-provided thrust availability is an input to the revised model.
